en: Color postcard-style illustration of a rural landscape with pine trees, farmhouses with red-tiled roofs and fenced paths. In the background on a wooded hill stands a large baroque pilgrimage church with two tall towers. In the foreground at right, a woman in traditional dress stands beside a wooden roadside shrine with a small religious image under a shingled roof. The caption at the top reads 'Maria Trost bei Graz.'.
